description: Exact sign and retrograde disagreement witnesses before gravitational-deflection correction. Coordinates are longitude degrees, latitude degrees, distance AU and corresponding rates per day. Linear boundary offsets are local tangent estimates, not solved crossing times.
scope: All eight sameUT sign disagreements and four Pluto retrograde disagreements in the fixed 172174-record baseline; complete all-body retrograde witnesses are emitted by compare-swiss.py.
